user.title: Lebensmittelwarnung.de
user.description: Select the warning type and federal state you want to follow.

reconfigure.title: Lebensmittelwarnung.de
reconfigure.description: Adjust the warning type and federal state.

abort.already_configured: This combination of warning type and federal state is already configured.

init.title: Watchlist
init.description: Keywords are searched for in the product, manufacturer and reason of each warning (case-insensitive, partial words match). Optionally, a product list from an entity can be checked as well, e.g. your Grocy stock. The "Watchlist Match" sensor is on while a warning from the last 7 days matches.

data_description.produkt_entity: Optional, e.g. sensor.grocy_stock. Leave empty to not use a product list.
data_description.produkt_attribut: Entity attribute holding the products as a list (Grocy: products).
data_description.produkt_namensfeld: Key of the name in each list item (Grocy: name). Ignored if the list contains plain strings.
